title: Plasmids in environmental microbes: An annotated selection of World Wide Web sites relevant to the topics in environmental microbiology
relevance_reason: The paper is about plasmids in environmental microbes; the 'vector database' mentioned is Addgene's molecular biology resource for plasmid backbones, not a computer science vector database for similarity or nearest-neighbor search.
research_focus: The composition and distribution of plasmids in environmental microbes, with a broader view than the typical focus on antibiotic resistance, and a compilation of plasmid/vector resources and databases.
method: Compilation of links and references to plasmid-related literature, databases, and resources (e.g., Addgene Vector Database, NCBI, EBI plasmid database, SnapGene).
application_domain: Molecular biology / biochemistry (plasmid and cloning vector research)
results_summary: The paper compiles references and links to resources related to plasmids in environmental microbes, noting that most plasmid studies focus on antibiotic resistance, which accounts for only 1% of plasmid genes. It highlights the Addgene Vector Database with 4,399 entries on vector backbones and points to various other plasmid sequence databases and annotation tools. The paper serves as a curated list of resources for plasmid detection, annotation, and engineering rather than presenting original experimental results. No quantitative findings or benchmarks are reported.
